ownerActions: PR #33 (Windows installer): when its Windows job is green, merge it, then download the ApparelPoS-Setup file from that CI run and try it on a spare Windows computer. Tell me what Windows shows.
Choose the real shop or company name and send an icon if you have one. The name decides the data folder on Windows and must never change after go-live (ADR-0018).

Try the app on a real Windows machine, end to end: install, owner set-up, recovery key (write it on paper), stock entry and hangtag print, billing, returns, shift open and close, daily report, backups to a USB drive and a folder, and a restore on a spare computer. Tell me what you see.
Print a hangtag sheet, a bill and a credit note slip on a real printer and scan the barcodes. Tell us the printer and scanner models.
Accept or reject the SQLCipher community licence (ADR-0003 point 7).
Switch on branch protection for main and develop; require branch-policy, build-lint-test and dart-flutter-windows.
Review ADR-0006, ADR-0013, ADR-0014 and ADR-0018 (Proposed).
Confirm earlier assistant choices (see the module documents): return and credit note choices, shift choices, the daily report profit definition, backup labels and limits.
Choose what comes next: P3-3b the runbook (recommended), P3-4 GST setup, P2-4d pay later (udhaar) or P2-4e markdown at the register.
